name: reslabs-reup
description: Verify a Res Labs tapped product and reorder it from the Demo Store, paying over MPP on Tempo Moderato testnet from the agent's wallet.

tools.name: reslabs_verify_tap
tools.description: Pay $0.001 pathUSD to check a Res Labs 5-minute share link and read the product, vendor, vendor batch, COA and reorder price.

tools.name: reslabs_reorder
tools.description: Reorder the verified product, paying the reorder price in pathUSD. Only after the user confirms product, vendor and price.

agent_key.title: Agent wallet private key
agent_key.description: Private key of the agent's Tempo Moderato testnet wallet (0x followed by 64 hex characters). Testnet funds only.

store_url.title: Demo Store URL
store_url.description: Base URL of the Demo Store.

mpp_recipient.title: Demo Store payment address
mpp_recipient.description: The only address the agent's wallet will pay: the Demo Store's MPP recipient on Tempo Moderato.
